datasets.title: Thailand - Satellite detected water extents from 1 Aug. 2024 to 22 October 2024 over Chiang Rai Province
datasets.description: UNOSAT code: FL20240912THA This map illustrates cumulative detected water using multiple satellites in Chiang Rai Province, Thailand from 1 August to 22 October 2024. Within the boundary of Chiang Rai Province of about 11,600 km², a total of about 875 km² of land appears to be affected by flood waters, with around 700 km² of cropland inundated. Based on Worldpop spatial demographic data, about 94,100 people are exposed or living close to flooded areas. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). This work is the result of collaboration between UNOSAT and GISTDA operating under the agreement of the UNOSAT Rapid Mapping Partners Initiative Programme. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/water-extents-from-1-aug-2024-to-22-october-2024-over-chiang-rai-province]
datasets.details: This is a preliminary assessment and has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics of the source imagery used in the analyses when interpreting results. For damage assessments it should be noted that only significant damage to the structural integrity of the buildings analyzed can be seen in imagery, while minor damage such as cracks or holes may not be visible at all. For flood extractions using radar data it is important to note that urban areas and highly vegetated areas may mask the flood signature and result in underestimation of flood waters. Users with specific questions or concerns should contact unosat@unitar.org to seek clarification.

lineage.description: UNOSAT analysts processed multi-temporal satellite imagery over Chiang Rai Province from 1 August to 22 October 2024, comparing successive images to detect notable changes and delineate cumulative water extents. WorldPop spatial demographic data was overlaid to estimate population exposure. The resulting geodatabase contains observed flood extent polygons and derived exposure statistics.
